fixes.problem: PA3 + PA4 Political HF Spaces returning 503, keepalive had no restart logic
fixes.root_cause: keepalive-spaces.sh only pinged spaces with curl but never triggered restart on failure
fixes.fix: Added ping_or_restart() bash function that calls POST https://huggingface.co/api/spaces/{space_id}/restart with HF_TOKEN_3 (Nomos42 account) when curl returns 503
fixes.status: FIXED — restart-on-503 active for all 10 spaces (6 NBA + 4 Political)

fixes.problem: All 961 insider trade records had transaction_type='unknown'
fixes.root_cause: fetch_insider_trades() used SEC EDGAR full-text search index endpoint (efts.sec.gov) which does NOT include transactionCode in search results. The code never fetched the actual Form 4 XML file.
fixes.fix: Added _parse_transaction_code_from_xml() which regexes <transactionCode>[A-Z]</transactionCode> from Form 4 XML. Added _fetch_form4_xml() that fetches the actual .xml filing from SEC /Archives/edgar/data/{cik}/{accession}/. Added _TRANSACTION_CODE_MAP: P=purchase, S=sale, F=forfeit, A=grant, D=sale, M/O/X/C=option_exercise, etc.
fixes.status: FIXED — transaction_type now populated via Form 4 XML parsing

fixes.problem: Reddit and Twitter/Nitter APIs returning empty (social signals zeroed)
fixes.root_cause: Nitter instances are intermittently down; Reddit JSON API blocked on server IPs without OAuth; no fallback source
fixes.fix: Added fetch_stocktwits_ticker() and fetch_stocktwits_signals() functions using free StockTwits public API: api.stocktwits.com/api/2/streams/symbol/{ticker}.json. No API key required. Returns explicit bullish/bearish sentiment per message. Wired as fallback in fetch_twitter_signals(): if Nitter returns 0 results, automatically falls back to StockTwits.
fixes.status: FIXED — StockTwits fallback active when Nitter returns empty

fixes.root_cause: POST payload missing required field 'filters.award_type_codes'. API returns HTTP 400: "Missing value: 'filters|award_type_codes' is a required field". Confirmed by direct API test.
fixes.fix: Added "award_type_codes": ["A", "B", "C", "D"] to filters payload. Codes: A=BPA Call, B=Purchase Order, C=Delivery Order, D=Definitive Contract.
fixes.status: FIXED — confirmed award_type_codes resolves the 400 error
